title: Magyar's Cabinet Ministers-Designate Complete Pre-Inauguration Briefings with Outgoing Officials
detail: In the final days before the May 9 inaugural session, ministers-designate in the Magyar government underwent pre-inauguration briefings with their outgoing Fidesz-era counterparts. The handover process, managed by an inter-ministerial commission, covered pending legislative dossiers, state contracts, and institutional protocols. Foreign Minister-designate Anita Orbán received briefings at the Orbán-era Ministry of Foreign Affairs on key bilateral relationships, NATO obligations, and the status of Paks II nuclear project negotiations. Finance Minister-designate András Kármán received briefings on the status of EU frozen funds negotiations and the August 31 Recovery and Resilience Facility deadline. Reports from Telex.hu indicated that some Fidesz-appointed civil servants declined to participate fully in handovers, requiring Magyar's transition team to rely heavily on EU Commission counterparts for policy context on the frozen funds dossier.

media.caption: Ministers-designate complete pre-inauguration briefings ahead of the May 9 swearing-in
